attributes.name: age
attributes.rationale: Age is present in the dataset and must be monitored for disparate outcomes.

objectives.name: Dataset completeness
objectives.description: Required training records must contain sufficiently complete values.
objectives.rationale: Incomplete required fields reduce reliability and create uneven error rates.

objectives.name: Representativeness across age groups
objectives.description: The dataset must not under-represent evaluated age groups.
objectives.rationale: Adequate representation supports reliable fairness evaluation across age groups.

assumptions: The tolerated representativeness gap of 10% is an assumption to be confirmed by the data owner.
